title: Comfort Club Dues Pricing Rules: Billing Basis, Web Discount and Renewal Pricing
content:
These pricing rules govern how dues on Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements are billed. Clauses marked as no longer in force remain listed so the record of the rules is complete; they are superseded by the current basis and are not applied.

## 1. Annual billing

1.1 *(No longer in force.)* The former clause by which annual dues for a term are the first-system annual rate plus the additional-system annual rate for each enrolled system beyond the first is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.

1.2 *(No longer in force.)* The former clause by which annual dues are billed once in advance as annual dues for the first term or renewal dues for later terms, with the billing month equal to the month in which the term starts, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## 2. Monthly billing (in force)

2.1 Monthly dues are the tier's monthly first-system rate plus the tier's monthly additional-system rate for each system beyond the first, billed as monthly dues on the first day of each calendar month for that month.

2.2 The first monthly charge posts on the enrollment date for the enrollment month in full, with no partial-month proration.

2.3 Monthly billing is available only with card-on-file or ACH autopay when the tier requires autopay for monthly billing.

## 3. Web enrollment discount (in force)

An agreement enrolled through the web channel receives the tier's web enrollment discount off every dues charge of its first term only. Renewal terms never carry it, and it does not apply to fees.

## 4. Renewal pricing

4.1 At an automatic renewal of an annually billed agreement on a tier that carries a price lock:
- *(No longer in force.)* the former clause setting the first-system rate for the new term at the lower of the agreement's locked rate and the current first-system annual rate is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis;
- *(No longer in force.)* the former clause billing additional systems at the current catalogue rate is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.

4.2 *(No longer in force.)* The former clause reducing the annual renewal dues after the price lock by the tier's loyalty discount once the renewing term's consecutive term count reaches the tier's loyalty term count is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.

4.3 Monthly agreements renew at the current monthly catalogue rates with neither price lock nor loyalty discount (in force).

## 5. General (in force)

5.1 Every discounted amount is rounded to the cent, half up.

5.2 A billing-frequency change requested mid-term is applied only at the next renewal.

## Worked examples on the in-force clauses (hypothetical agreements)

- *Monthly dues, three systems on Comfort Club Gold:* the monthly first-system rate of 22.45 plus two times the monthly additional-system rate of 14.95 gives monthly dues of 52.35 USD, billed on the first of each month.
- *Web enrollment, monthly, one system on Comfort Club Silver:* 17.95 less the 5% web discount is 17.0525, rounded half up to 17.05 USD for each monthly charge of the first term; the renewal term's monthly charges are billed at the catalogue rate without the discount.
- *Enrollment on the 20th of a month, monthly billing:* the first monthly charge posts that day for the whole month; no partial-month amount is computed.
